item.title: 2170 Assembly-Line Good Yield: About 40%→98.7%
item.description:
30-second summary

Before trying to improve the yield number, I separated inspection errors from actual process defects so that equipment and process actions targeted the right cause.

Production stabilization result
Period / basis
During tenure at Kumyang · May 2024–Sep 2025
Project form
Company project · Assembly process lead

Problem to solve

Effective good yield was initially about 40%, while production, quality, and equipment teams were using different denominators and defect definitions.

item.title: Maintenance Engineer Exam Masterbook
item.description:
30-second summary

Useful learning requires more than showing many questions: answers must remain hidden before submission, and evidence must explain why an answer is right or wrong afterward.

Live · Selected material remains deferred
Period / basis
Last completed validation snapshot · Jul 30, 2026
Project form
Personal AI use · Evidence-based learning platform

Problem to solve

Question, answer, explanation, source, and rights status were mixed, so automatically publishing weakly supported material risked incorrect learning and rights issues.

item.title: NCM Prismatic Pilot Line: FAT/SAT for 13 Processes and 11 Systems
item.description:
30-second summary

Equipment acceptance is not complete when a machine merely runs; product tolerance, repeatability, safety, and production readiness must be checked against shared criteria.

Equipment acceptance and initial production stabilization
Period / basis
During the relevant employment · May 2023–May 2024
Project form
Company project · Pilot-line commissioning and operation

Problem to solve

Thirteen processes and eleven key machines required aligned acceptance criteria, supplier actions, retest records, and a daily 200-cell production plan.

item.title: Official-Source Unemployment Benefit Guidebook
item.description:
30-second summary

Unemployment-benefit questions are safer when categorized and linked to official and individual verification paths rather than answered with a simple eligibility verdict.

Live · Policies may change
Period / basis
Public validation snapshot · Jul 19, 2026
Project form
Personal AI use · Official-source Q&A

Problem to solve

Similar questions can have different answers depending on separation reason, insured period, and individual notices, so general guidance must not replace administrative decisions.

item.title: Ontology- and LLM-Wiki-Based AI Agent Platform
item.description:
30-second summary

A platform that selects domain knowledge and rules from an ontology and LLM wiki to compose and run AI agents with defined roles, tools, evidence, and stop conditions. Authority and evidence checks form its execution-safety layer.

Agent composition and local execution foundation verified · not connected to production
Period / basis
Last completed local validation snapshot · Jul 2026
Project form
Personal AI use · Ontology- and LLM-wiki-based agent platform

Problem to solve

Repeating knowledge, tools, and rules in every long prompt creates inconsistent terminology and opaque agent definitions. Mixing in execution authority can also lead to an unapproved external change.

item.title: Semiconductor and Display-Part Surface Treatment and Measurement Correlation
item.description:
30-second summary

Matching process conditions alone was not enough; bath condition and cross-instrument differences had to be understood so internal and customer measurements agreed.

Process and inspection criteria applied to production
Period / basis
During tenure at YMC · Mar 2016–Jan 2021
Project form
Company project · Surface-treatment process development and qualification

Problem to solve

If anodizing, etching, cleaning, bath analysis, and inspection measurements were not connected, sample results varied and qualification criteria were difficult to align.

item.title: Vacuum-Robot Overhaul: Turning Verbal Know-How into SOPs
item.description:
30-second summary

An overhaul process dependent on individual memory had to be documented as work and inspection criteria so different operators could reproduce the same quality.

SOP and checklist applied in work
Period / basis
During tenure at Bontech · Feb 2021–Mar 2022
Project form
Company project · Precision-assembly standardization

Problem to solve

Disassembly and assembly order, torque, alignment, leak, and repeatability checks were largely passed on verbally, creating omission and operator-variation risk.

item.title: Deep Learning Modeling Textbook: Reproducible Experiments for Manufacturing Data
item.description:
30-second summary

For manufacturing data, a repeatable path from preprocessing through evaluation matters more than listing many model names.

Learning workflow public · Before manufacturing validation
Period / basis
Personal learning project · Current public-repository scope
Project form
Reproducible modeling study repository

Problem to solve

When preprocessing, split, training, and evaluation conditions are scattered, it is difficult to explain whether performance differences come from the model or data handling.

item.title: AI Vision Modeling for Weld Defect Detection
item.description:
30-second summary

On the shop floor, the cost of missing a defect can matter more than aggregate accuracy, so the PoC separated data sources and prioritized recall and threshold decisions.

Detection-criteria evaluation stage
Period / basis
Training team project · Public case updated Jul 2026
Project form
Manufacturing DX PoC · Before production use

Problem to solve

A model that performs well on public data cannot be assumed to behave the same on field images with different lighting, angles, and surface conditions.

item.title: Collaborative-Robot Assembly Twin and Edge-Vision PoC
item.description:
The problem

Separate demonstrations of robot motion, vision results, PLC sequences, and MES records do not reconstruct what happened to one product.

This education team PoC used a QR serial as the common key across an Indy7 assembly flow, edge-vision inspection, PLC and SCADA, MySQL/MES, and digital-twin state.

Area Public scope
Project type Education team PoC
My role Robot and Digital Twin
Team implementation QR traceability, robot sequence, vision, PLC/SCADA, and MES
Technologies Indy7, Python, YOLO, Raspberry Pi, Hailo, PLC, and MySQL
Current status Education demo complete; plant pilot and long-running E2E unverified

Team output and my individual role are kept separate. I do not present the full team result as a solo achievement, and the original report containing teammate identities is not published.

item.title: GIGA Press Expansion Digital Twin PoC
item.description:
What an interviewer should confirm in 30 seconds

Item Scope
Project form A 10-person training-team PoC, not a live GIGA Press installation
Problem Reduce rework caused by first aligning sequences, interlocks, screen tags, and upper-layer data on physical equipment
What I led Overall planning of the topic, problem, scope, architecture, and integration order; final-report writing
Direct hands-on scope The Digital Twin–AI integration structure, including the AI insertion point and authority boundary
Teammate implementation Detailed PLC Ladder/Factory I/O and SCADA/OPC UA implementation
Verified output An integrated Factory I/O–PLC/Ladder–SCADA/OPC UA–web team demo and final report
Not verified Physical GIGA Press behavior, safety PLC, HIL/FAT, production impact, or DQN closed-loop performance

I was not the project manager or the sole developer. The team lead managed schedule, risk, and the final presentation. I led the overall structure and integration order, wrote the final report, and directly worked on the Digital Twin–AI connection. This distinction shows system-level judgement without attributing teammates’ Ladder and SCADA work to me.

item.title: HeungTology: Finding Industrial Knowledge with Traceable Sources
item.description:
30-second summary

The same equipment or quality concept can be named differently across departments and documents, so terminology and relationships need an explicit contract before evidence-backed retrieval is possible.

Limited to what the public repository supports
Period / basis
Personal project · Current public-repository scope
Project form
Manufacturing knowledge data and retrieval

Problem to solve

Keyword search over manufacturing documents with Korean, English, acronyms, and synonyms can miss equivalent concepts or mix different meanings.

item.title: Indy7 Automotive-Factory Control and Traceability Digital Twin PoC
item.description:
What an interviewer should confirm in 30 seconds

Item Scope
Project A 10-person automotive-factory training PoC connecting QR, vision, collaborative robots, PLC/SCADA, and a database
Problem Individual robot motion was not enough; product identity, completion state, inspection result, and loading history had to remain connected
What I led Overall planning of the project goal, process scenario, system structure, and cross-team integration order
Direct hands-on scope Indy7 control, command/state integration between stations, robot programs, and integrated-flow validation
Team boundary Detailed vision, PLC Ladder, and SCADA/database work belonged to teammates; the team lead owned the report, schedule, and final presentation
Verified output Physical flow from QR capture through body/window assembly, vision inspection, and good/defect routing
Later extension PC-HMI, Conty JSON, IndyDCP, MQTT, history services, and a read-only web twin were developed later as a separate public-code scope

How to read this table: I led the project problem framing and integration order. My direct implementation centered on Indy7 control and process integration, while detailed vision, Ladder, SCADA, and team-lead responsibilities remain separately attributed.
